context: Checks the generator preserves existing configuration, honours project boundaries, applies schema defaults and is dry-run validated, per the nx-plugin-authoring skill.

checklist.name: Reads existing configuration
checklist.description: The generator calls `readProjectConfiguration(tree, name)` before changing anything.

checklist.name: Updates rather than overwrites
checklist.description: The generator assigns the new target onto the read configuration and saves it with `updateProjectConfiguration`, not by writing a whole new project.json.

checklist.name: Existing targets preserved
checklist.description: The `lint` and `test` targets and the existing tags are still present after the update.

checklist.name: Checks tags before cross-scope changes
checklist.description: The generator or its notes verify tags and dependency direction so a `scope:ui` project is not wired to `scope:data`.

checklist.name: Respects project graph boundaries
checklist.description: The solution explicitly states generated output must not introduce a forbidden dependency between scopes.

checklist.name: Schema has typed options
checklist.description: `schema.json` defines `name` as a required string with a description and `directory` as an optional string.

checklist.name: Safe default for omitted directory
checklist.description: When `directory` is omitted the generator uses the workspace default location or a schema default.

checklist.name: Uses Tree API for the note
checklist.description: `BUILD.md` is created with `tree.write` or `generateFiles`, not `fs` calls.

checklist.name: Dry-run validation before rollout
checklist.description: The answer includes running the generator with `--dry-run` before applying it across the workspace.

checklist.name: Stops on unexpected output
checklist.description: The answer says to stop if unexpected files appear or required options fail validation.
